tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Health check for Home Office Builder. Returns ok, storage, paapi, trackingTag, tagConfigured, domain, catalogCount. tagConfigured is false until real Associates IDs are set (links omit tag=). OpenAPI: getHealth.

tools.name: search_desk_gear
tools.description: Search Amazon for home-office desk gear on the user's marketplace. Filter by role + budgetBand. Returns PA-API products when configured, otherwise desk-setup search deep-link cards + catalogMatches. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. Amazon URLs omit tag= until tagConfigured is true. OpenAPI: searchA

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Paginated curated desk starters (~51). Prefer search_desk_gear for discovery. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. Filter by role + budgetBand. OpenAPI: getCatalog.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve an ASIN, pasted Amazon /dp/ URL, or keywords to an buyUrl (product /dp or desk search). ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. Does not invent tracking tags — when unset, URLs omit tag= and tagConfigured is false. OpenAPI: resolveProduct.

tools.name: create_desk_board
tools.description: Create a home-office desk board (wishlist). Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl, wishlist, storage. Save editToken for add_desk_item. Prefer create_and_fill for one-shot. OpenAPI: createWishlist.

tools.name: create_and_fill
tools.description: One call: create a curated home office setup gift wishlist and return shopUrl (share link) + ownerUrl. Preferred agent path: create a desk board and add ASINs / keywords / search queries in one call. Pass marketplace + locale + role + budgetBand. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl. OpenAPI: ag

tools.name: get_desk_board
tools.description: Fetch a desk board by id. Returns items with buy links when available, plus ownerUrl and shopUrl. OpenAPI: getWishlist.

tools.name: add_desk_item
tools.description: Add an item to a desk board. Requires editToken from create. Body: name/title plus asin, url (pasted /dp), searchKeywords, or catalogId. Token storage may return a new id — update bookmarks. OpenAPI: addWishlistItem.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_desk_gear, resolve_product · Private data: add_desk_item · Public sink: create_and_fill.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_desk_gear, resolve_product · Private data: add_desk_item · Public sink: create_and_fill

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
